intro: Research Points (RP) are the currency you use to unlock higher shop tiers, buy from The Masked Man and get blueprints from The Craftsman. They've been in the game since it launched on June 12, 2015.

crates.name: Basic Crate
crates.info: The lowest tier and the most common. Found all over the map.

crates.name: Unobtainium Crystal Crate
crates.info: About the size of a Basic Crate, with purple wood and a soft purple glow. The first crate added after the Combat Update.
crates.spawn: Spawns randomly around the map, or from a VIP+ Daily Gift

crates.name: Shadow Crate
crates.info: Small, black and see-through, so it's hard to spot. About as common as Golden Crates, but only at night. With the Void Cube artifact, 2–5 spawn right on your base during the night.

crates.name: Giant Unobtainium Crystal Crate
crates.info: A supersized Unobtainium Crystal Crate, about as big as a Diamond Crate, with more crystals inside.

crates.name: Golden Crate
crates.info: Bigger and rarer than a Basic Crate, and it glows. With Premium Mining every Golden Crate has a Lucky Clover.
crates.spawn: Spawns randomly around the map, or from a VIP+ Daily Gift

crates.name: Lucky Crate
crates.info: Added in The Ultimate Update. Green foil with clover particles, and the chat announces it when it lands.

crates.name: Diamond Crate
crates.info: Very rare and very valuable. Almost always comes with a Mystery Box, from a Regular Box all the way up to a Red-Banded Box.
crates.spawn: Spawns randomly, announced in chat. Also from a VIP+ Daily Gift

crates.name: Gift Crate
crates.info: Drops when you open your Daily Gift. Only the player who opened the gift can collect it. Added in the Xbox Update.

crates.name: Executive Crate
crates.info: Replaces the normal crate in your Daily Gift if you own the Executive gamepass. Can't drop naturally.

crates.name: Crate Storm
crates.info: Rains a batch of research crates over your whole server for anyone to grab. Never drops event, Gift, Executive or Shadow crates.
contents: A shower of crates for your server

crates.name: Global Crate Storm
crates.info: Released 10 July 2021. Like a Crate Storm, but it rains crates in every server at once.

crates.name: Giant Crate
crates.info: An enormous dark wooden crate that drops with your Daily Gift if you bought the Giant Crate artifact on Black Friday 2016.
contents: 10% chance of a Regular, Unreal or Inferno Box

crates.name: Cursed Crate
crates.info: For owners of the Corrupt Pearl artifact (2017, and briefly in 2019). Holds a large amount of RP.

crates.name: Blazing Crate
crates.info: A neon orange crate for owners of the UY Scuti artifact from Black Friday 2019.

crates.name: Golden Gift
crates.info: A small, bright yellow gift added in the 2016 Winter Update. Spawns day and night, but only in winter.
contents: Regular, Unreal, Inferno or Festive Box

crates.name: Birthday Crate
crates.info: Pink wood with sprinkles and a bow, added for the Tenth Anniversary so players could earn items otherwise sold in the premium shop.
contents: One random Birthday Box item (three if it's a conveyor)

crates.name: New Years Crate
crates.info: A black crate that shoots coloured fireworks. Added for New Years 2026 to bring back the 2020 and 2021 New Year's items.
contents: Disco Flooring ×3, Firework Mine, Firework Pile, Spotlight Cannon, Confetti Particle or New Years Monument

crates.name: Pot of Gold
crates.info: The biggest crate of the St. Patrick's Day event. No RP, but a pile of Golden Clovers for the event shop.

crates.name: Evil Pumpkin
crates.info: A glowing pumpkin from the 2016 Spooky Update. Gives no RP, just Pumpkin Boxes. Touch 100 for a Pumpkin Hero.

crates.name: Candy Crate
crates.info: A candy corn shaped crate added in part 2 of Halloween 2019 to help players who couldn't make candy fast.

uses.title: Unlock shop tiers
uses.text: Super Rare and above stay locked until you've earned enough RP. Almighty is the most expensive at 400k RP.

uses.title: Buy from The Masked Man
uses.text: Some of his Contraband items are sold for RP, usually for tens or hundreds of thousands.

uses.title: Craftsman blueprints
uses.text: You need a blueprint before The Craftsman will fuse or evolve a Reborn item. Blueprints are paid for with RP. The priciest is Tortoise Fortifier at 2.5M RP.

uses.title: The RP leaderboard
uses.text: There's a public RP leaderboard by the tower, next to the other leaderboards.

furnaces.name: Industrial Scarab
furnaces.cond: Flaming ore gets a much worse multiplier and needs 1 more ore per payout

furnaces.name: Innovator's Research Center
furnaces.cond: Only counts ore from Fire, Ice and Lightning Mines

furnaces.name: The Great Parasite
furnaces.cond: A random roll when you rebirth

furnaces.name: Nature's Enchantment
furnaces.cond: A random roll when you rebirth

furnaces.name: Nuclear Castle
furnaces.cond: Radioactive ore for the top multiplier

furnaces.name: Nuclear Stronghold
furnaces.cond: Radioactive ore for the top multiplier

picks.text: Both have a high RP rate and are Slipstream items, so you can roll them from life 2. They vanish when you rebirth, though. Nuclear Stronghold and Nuclear Castle are solid Reborn picks too.
The best RP furnace right now at about 3.1 RP per ore.
3 RP per ore, but only from Fire, Ice and Lightning Mines, so you need a lot of them.

mines.name: Breech Loader
mines.note: or Diamond Breech Loader, which is taller

tips.d: Drop every mine straight into a teleporter sender and put the receiver right before a single furnace. It saves space and it's fast.
Fill your base with shop mines like Silver or Painite Mines, teleport the ore and drop it into one Research Center or another high-RP furnace.
A full base of Painite Mines feeding one Industrial Scarab through teleporters makes around 1 million RP an hour.
Tall mines like the Breech Loader waste time while ore falls. Put an Anti-Gravity or Hydraulic Teleporter sender at the spout and drop the ore onto a conveyor into the furnace.

Fast mines fill the ore limit quickly. Feeding furnaces on Hydraulic Platforms directly from the mines (e.g. 2 Wubium Mines through a Witch's Cauldron) uses about 85–95 of the limit instead of 175–200.
Box in the spout with walls (a Controlled Gate makes a one-tile wall), or catch the ore with a Hydraulic Platform and a teleporter sender.
Sawmill → reset → Ore Replicator before the furnace takes too long per ore, so fewer ores get processed each second.
An autoclicker that only clicks is allowed to stop you being kicked. If it moves the cursor, it counts as a macro and can get you banned.
RP farms cause lag. Use a Private Island or private server so you don't slow other players down, and so their bases don't slow you.
Keep 400k RP in reserve before building your setup, so you can buy the Ore Transponder when you go for CENT with the Overlord's Telamonster.

history.title: Launch
history.text: RP is in the game from day one.

history.title: Combat Update
history.text: Killing another player steals 1% of their RP.

history.title: RP stealing removed
history.text: Gone in the first part of the Winter Event 2015.

history.title: Xbox Update
history.text: The RP shop and weapons are removed to make the game more kid-friendly. RP loses most of its use, which causes a lot of debate.

history.title: Christmas 2019
history.text: Some weapons and shop items come back, but they aren't bought with RP.

history.title: Reincarnation Update
history.text: Crafting arrives. Blueprints for Reborn Fusions and Evolved Reborns cost RP, and almost every furnace now gives RP.

related.name: Gift of Research
related.text: A present from Santa that unwraps into 100 to 1,000 RP.

related.name: Research Points Trophy
related.text: Awarded to the Addicted Miners clan for winning the 2017 RP contest. You can still get it by joining the group.

trivia: After part II of the 2015 Winter Update, chat announced a "Rainbow Crate". It was a prank by Berezaa and players weren't happy. The announcement showed up again in Halloween 2020.
Gift Crates sometimes give half a research point on top of the usual amount.
Crates can vanish without warning, usually after 1–3 minutes, sometimes almost instantly.
In public servers crates don't collide with ore, so they can't clog your setup. Players can still bump into them.
With a Lucky Infuser, every crate gives a Lucky Clover.
During Halloween 2019 every crate became pumpkin-shaped. All crates got a new design straight after.
